name: view_duel_rejoin_claims_its_own_bottle
description: A game that comes back to a duel takes back only the bottles its salts were committed to (contract-m7.md §3, Game._claim_corked), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. Game.salt_match stands in for the MatchClient's match id. In window 2 my CORK is filed in user://duel/77-1.cfg and lost on its way, and the game dies (its memory of the duel gone, the file kept). My seat is AWAY, and the caretaker corks for it with salt 0. The game comes back (BACK; Game attached to the match again, as a rejoin's RESYNC does) and takes the waiting salt back from the file, but the caretaker's bottle of the same window is not committed to it: it takes no salt of mine, shows the caretaker's pack, and the caretaker uncorks it itself in wave 2, with no UNCORK of mine sent to it.

steps.msg: key 1 corks, and the CORK never reaches the turns
its salt is filed as it goes out
the game dies: nothing of the duel is left in it, the file stays
my seat is away: the caretaker corked for it with salt 0, and no CORK of mine ran

steps.assert: not Game._corks.has(bottle) and Game.my_bottles()[0]['id'] == bottle and not Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['caretaker'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == theirs
steps.msg: back in match 77 the game took its salt back from the file, but the caretaker's bottle of that window is not committed to it: it takes no salt of mine and shows the caretaker's pack

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['pack'] == theirs and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).is_empty() and Game.my_bottles().is_empty()
steps.msg: the caretaker uncorked it itself at 3 s; no UNCORK of mine went to it
